criteria.criterion: Complete affected caller inventory uses existing canonical prefix/native-facts/resource/digest code; redundant production paths removed or each retained path has a concrete different contract and actual supported consumer. No partial local fix claimed as whole consolidation.

Actual same-input measurements demonstrate fewer full materializations/reads/rehashes/encodings without shifted work; exact values and currentness/stale/copied/foreign/rollback refusals preserved. Event-log intervals and measured CPU causes remain distinguished.

Actual candidate installed producer-consumer and maintained SDK borrowed-resource setup execute with exact final close, failure ownership and cold reopen; fresh result/replay and event semantics preserved, no replacement runtime or authority.

All R1-R7 red-flag categories and startup/digest caller families have explicit evidence-backed dispositions. Required work information, original outcome/rubric/current input/provenance remain sufficient while unrelated archive/history carriage and broad searches are removed from the current task.

Actual affected C2 source corresponds to frozen native return, all selected commands pass, new consolidation cases execute without optional skips, independent review conjoins, and historical evidence/releases stay unchanged. No full qualification or general speedup claim.
